items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: That London Blues, the Sunday Sweetheart, that was with Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: Could it have been the Horace Eubanks song?

No, I could have had a record though with Horace Eubanks. That London Blues, the Sunday Sweetheart, that was with Buster Bailey. Buster Bailey. Buster Bailey, that's in New York now. That played with John Kirby's band.
